rules.strength: strictly higher season PPG AND last-five PPG
rules.shooting: home/away venue shot proxy favours home
rules.timing: recorded starters assumed available at lineup time; history >24h before kickoff
rules.benchmark_universe: same home starters and team-history eligibility; no strength/shooting filter

plan.label: Ligue 1 2015/16
plan.selection_reason: Closest-to-complete unused European men's league season in the inspected catalog; not selected by player outcomes.
plan.B: A AND prior five-start average shots >=3 AND prior five-start average minutes >=80
plan.primary_comparison: All qualifying A and B picks in available records; report discarded A picks and paired match-week clustered bootstrap interval for B-minus-A rate difference.
plan.coverage_sensitivity: Repeat both unchanged rules after excluding candidate fixtures when either team's earlier scheduled rounds are absent from downloaded history. Conservatively exclude missing-round history; never fabricate stats.
research_outputs: all A picks and B flags
plan.interpretation: New evaluation dataset relative to prior refinement research, but same era/provider and only partial season coverage. No threshold tuning. No automatic rule promotion. No profit claim.

limits: Partial coverage: three expected fixture pairings absent. Missing match dates/stats are not invented.
Prior-round sensitivity is conservative: it also removes picks before postponed earlier rounds were played.
Independent of refinement discovery matches, but same provider and 2015/16 era as other European tests.
Paired weekly bootstrap accounts for within-week dependence, not all persistent player/team dependence. Interval is approximate.
Actual starter assumed known; StatsBomb published clock has no timezone offset; history buffer >24h. Historical publication availability not verified.
Minutes and shots follow the existing StatsBomb adapter. No odds or profit test. No rule promotion or retuning.
